rationale: There is empirical support demonstrating that an ATP-binding motif variant in DHX9 (p.Gly414Arg) was found in a patient with left ventricular non-compaction cardiomyopathy (LVNC) and caused cardiac conduction abnormalities in a knock-in mouse model (Yamada et al., 2023). However, asserting that LVNC or primary cardiac conduction defects distinguish DHX9 ATP-binding motif variants from DHX30-related disorders is contradicted by critical limitations: the observation in DHX9 rests upon an N=1 patient report, broader cohorts demonstrate DHX9 monoallelic variants present heterogeneously with neurodevelopmental disorders and Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease without recurrent LVNC (Lalani, 2023), and no systematic comparative cohort studies exist establishing this finding as a discriminative diagnostic marker against DHX30.

evidence.text: Yamada et al. identified a de novo heterozygous missense variant p.(Gly414Arg) in the ATP-binding site of DHX9 in an individual with short stature, intellectual disability, and ventricular non-compaction cardiomyopathy; homologous knock-in mice exhibited cardiac conduction abnormalities.

source.title: Heterozygous loss-of-function DHX9 variants are associated with neurodevelopmental disorders: Human genetic and experimental evidences
source.quote: Herein, we report a patients with a heterozygous de novo missense variant, p.(Gly414Arg) of DHX9 who presented with a short stature, intellectual disability, and ventricular non-compaction cardiomyopathy. The variant was located in the glycine codon of the ATP-binding site, G-C-G-K-T.

numbers.metric: patients reported with p.Gly414Arg and ventricular non-compaction cardiomyopathy

evidence.text: Broader systematic characterization indicates that monoallelic variation in DHX9 underlies neurodevelopmental disorders and Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease, demonstrating broader phenotypic pleiotropy rather than an exclusive or specific presentation of cardiomyopathy.

source.title: SEEMA LALANI
source.quote: Monoallelic variation in DHX9, the gene encoding the DExH-box helicase DHX9, underlies neurodevelopment disorders and Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease. Am J Hum Genet. 2023 08

evidence.text: Left ventricular non-compaction cardiomyopathy demonstrates extensive genetic and phenotypic heterogeneity, with multiple causative pathways and inconsistent diagnostic thresholds, limiting its reliability as a distinct discriminator between specific helicase-associated syndromic entities.

source.title: Left ventricular noncompaction: a disorder with genotypic and phenotypic heterogeneity—a narrative review
source.quote: This review reflects the current lack of clarity regarding the pathogenesis and significance of LVNC and showed the complexity of imaging diagnostic criteria, interpretation of the role of LVNC as a cause, and uncertainty regarding the specific genetic basis of LVNC.

conflicts: The proposed distinction relies on a single patient (N=1) with the p.Gly414Arg variant and ventricular non-compaction cardiomyopathy; no multicenter series confirms penetrance of LVNC across patients with DHX9 ATP-binding motif variants.

Larger cohorts of DHX9-related neurodevelopmental disorder and Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease do not establish LVNC or primary cardiac conduction defects as a recurrent cardinal feature separating DHX9 from DHX30.

No prospective or retrospective cohort comparison between DHX9 and DHX30 cohorts has been performed to evaluate the diagnostic sensitivity or specificity of cardiomyopathy versus structural septal defects.

new_directions.question_text: In comprehensive international cohorts of individuals with DHX9 pathogenic variants, what is the exact penetrance of structural heart defects, left ventricular non-compaction, and cardiac conduction abnormalities?
new_directions.rationale: Determining the true numerator and denominator of cardiac findings across all published and registry cases of DHX9 is required before any cardiac phenotype can be considered a reliable clinical discriminator.

new_directions.question_text: Does direct head-to-head phenotypic comparison of individuals with DHX9 versus DHX30 variants reveal statistically significant differences in cardiovascular anomalies?
new_directions.rationale: Comparing cardiac phenotypes between matched cohorts of DHX9 and DHX30 individuals would empirically establish whether LVNC or conduction system defects exhibit discriminatory diagnostic power.
